title: Priv EKS controlplane provisioner: orchestrated upgrade & healthhooks terraform kit
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Build a reusable Terraform module and a small operator-style orchestration wrapper for Redwood Private EKS control plane provisioning that provides idempotent provisioning, preflight validations, rolling/blue-green upgrade orchestration, and liveness/healthhooks integration for automated repair and safe rollbacks.

Goals:
- Single Terraform module that can provision EKS control plane components across customer VPCs with clear inputs for networking, KMS keys, cross-account roles, and bootstrap config.
- Built-in preflight validations (IAM boundary, VPC/subnet mapping, route table checks, required service endpoints) surfaced as plan-time failures or informative warnings.
- Orchestrated upgrade path: support canary nodegroups, cordon/drain sequencing, and control-plane-safe rollback hooks.
- Healthhooks: manifested as a configurable set of probes and SLO-based gates integrated with CloudWatch/Prometheus metrics and an optional self-healing hook to trigger reconciliation.
- Integrate with existing KMS cross-account patterns and provide outputs compatible with Private control-plane lifecycle automation.

Non-goals:
- Not implementing a full Kubernetes operator in this ticket (we will provide a lightweight orchestration wrapper and CRD examples for follow-ups).
- Not changing networking or tenant isolation patterns - must be compatible with current VPC blueprints.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Terraform module published to internal registry with version v0.1.0 and full README.
2) Module accepts inputs for kms_key_arn, cross_account_role_arn, control_plane_tagging map, and canary_strategy config.
3) Plan/apply idempotency validated in CI against a mocked test account (terraform-integration job).
4) Preflight validations implemented as sentinel-style checks (policy) and as terraform validation and produce actionable messages.
5) One documented upgrade scenario: canary nodegroup promotion then staggered rollout with health hook gating.
6) Observability hooks emit standardized metrics and an example Grafana dashboard is provided.
7) Security review completed and signoff captured in the ticket.

Deliverables:
- sources/terraform/modules/priv-eks-controlplane (module code) (artifact in repo: gitlab.com/redwood/private-terraform/modules/priv-eks-controlplane)
tests: terraform-integration (CI) - runs plan/apply against test account
preflight-e2e - validates sentinel policies against sample manifests
upgrade-smoke - validates canary promotion in staging cluster
rollout_plan: 1) Merge feature branch to staging, trigger terraform-integration
2) Deploy module v0.1.0 to staging customer account (manual approval), run upgrade-smoke
3) Promote to limited production tenants (2 customers) behind feature flag
4) Monitor for 72h, if metrics stable promote wide rollout
5) If health gating fails, automated rollback to previous module version and open incident runbook
notes: Trade-offs: Implementing sentinel-style policy checks improves safety but adds friction to rapid iteration. We will provide an override path with an explicit risk-ack token for emergency applies.
Decision: prefer terraform native validations and external policy checks rather than embedding business logic into module resources to keep module composable.
KMS handling: use existing cross-account KMS role pattern from infra library to avoid reintroducing secret-sharing paths.
Observability: emit controlplane_upgrade_status, controlplane_health_score, and last_successful_rollout tags to unify with Console dashboards.
